microbe_motif.description: Recurring small organic dots/blobs used for bullets, list markers, active-state indicators, connecting stages. NEVER as full-bleed background.
microbe_motif.implementation: SVG blobs or rounded-full divs, occasionally animated with Framer Motion (floating, pulsating softly).

photography.style: Real field/lab/expedition/facility photography. NO duotones. NO heavy color overlays.
photography.overlay_rule: If text is over an image, use bg-[#1C3A1F]/30 or bg-[#1C3A1F]/40 for contrast. Max 50% opacity. Never full blanket.
photography.treatment: Clipped frames, sharp precision edges, or rounded-2xl (16px max). Spotlight specific subject areas.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #5C5C5C/20 for subtle structure on cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows shadow-sm or shadow-md for floating elements. Avoid heavy dark shadows.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2D6A35] text-white hover:bg-[#1C3A1F] transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold border-none. NO gradients.
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1C3A1F] border-2 border-[#1C3A1F] hover:bg-[#F7F6F2] transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold.

badges.style: bg-[#F5C842] or bg-[#E8A500] text-[#1C3A1F] font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase px-3 py-1 rounded-full
badges.usage: Use sparingly for certifications, 'New', or highlight labels.

cards.rule: Max ONE accent color per card (e.g., icon in #43B14B, or bottom border line).

forms.input: bg-white border border-[#5C5C5C]/30 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-[#1A1A1A] placeholder:text-[#5C5C5C] focus:border-[#43B14B] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#43B14B] outline-none transition-all
forms.label: text-sm font-semibold text-[#1C3A1F] mb-2 block

navigation.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#1C3A1F] text-white shadow-md
navigation.links: text-white/80 hover:text-[#43B14B] transition-colors font-medium text-sm lg:text-base
navigation.active_state: text-[#43B14B] relative after:content-[''] after:absolute after:-bottom-1 after:left-1/2 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:w-1.5 after:h-1.5 after:bg-[#43B14B] after:rounded-full

grids.bento_concept: For About Us / Stats, use asymmetrical grids. E.g., col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero imagery, col-span-4 for stat readouts.

layouts.spacing_scale: py-16 md:py-24 lg:py-32 for section vertical rhythm. Generous whitespace is critical.

home_page.hero: Kinetic typography 'Grow More. Harm Less. With Microbes.' Masked line-by-line reveal via Framer Motion. Subtle microbe dots floating behind. High-res agriculture image with 30% forest deep overlay.
home_page.trust_bar: Animated counters (2008, 120+, 16+, 15k+) scrolling horizontally or in a dense grid, with certification badges.
home_page.solutions: 3 category cards (Fertilizers, Protection, Remediation) with #F7F6F2 backgrounds, heavy typography, and arrow icons on hover.
home_page.discovery_teaser: 3-checkpoint timeline layout connecting with the microbe motif (spore yellow dots).
home_page.testimonials: Swiper carousel, clean white cards on off-white background.
home_page.cta_strip: High-impact dark green (#1C3A1F) section with WhatsApp button.

our_sciences_page.manifesto: Numbered 6-stage flowing process (Bioprospecting -> Isolate -> Stabilization -> Formulation -> Validation -> Scale). Use sticky scroll-jacking. As user scrolls down, numbers 01 to 06 reveal alongside high-res lab imagery and text.
our_sciences_page.marquee: Slow editorial marquee passing through text 'ORIGIN • RIGOUR • TRACK RECORD' in serif or bold Poppins.

solutions_hub.filters: Sticky sidebar or top bar with search and pill-shaped filters (solution type, crop).
solutions_hub.grid: Responsive grid of product cards with clear imagery and quick-add/detail buttons.

product_detail.header: Split layout. Left: Product image in clean studio light or lab context. Right: Title, badging, description, WhatsApp CTA.
product_detail.data: Formulation and application tables using Shadcn tables styled with #F7F6F2 header rows and #1A1A1A text.

motion.scrolling: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium 'Awwwards' feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Text elements should be wrapped in overflow-hidden divs. Animate Y from 100% to 0% over 0.8s, stagger 0.1s. Ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion.parallax: Apply subtle `y` transforms linked to scroll progress (useScroll, useTransform) on large background images or floating microbe motifs.
motion.hover_states: Buttons scale up by 1.02. Cards lift by -Y 4px and shadow increases.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in / subtle translate Y on route changes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #1C3A1F and #2D6A35 passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring in #43B14B.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons and WhatsApp CTAs.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all major interactive components (e.g., data-testid='solutions-filter-btn').

hero_agriculture.description: High angle shot of lush green cropland. Perfect for hero background.

modern_farm.description: Rows of green crops at sunset. Use for 'From Discovery to Field' or Solutions.

laboratory.description: Scientist in modern lab setting. Use for 'Our Sciences' and 'About Us'.

microbes.description: Abstract biology cells. Use as decorative card imagery or 'Stabilization' section.

facilities.description: Vibrant test tubes in modern lab. Use for facilities or formulation page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT substitute primary/secondary colors.
Implement the 'Microbe Motif' using Framer Motion to create floating SVG dots colored in #F5C842 or #43B14B to connect sections visually.
Use @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling in App.js or Layout wrapper.
Ensure the hero heading is bold, tight tracking, and reveals line-by-line using framer-motion.
Avoid using generic rounded corners everywhere. Stick to sharp edges or deliberate rounded-2xl (16px) for cards, and rounded-full for buttons/badges.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out-of-the-box without restyling them to match this strict color scheme.
Use lucide-react for icons. Apply #43B14B to icon strokes to make them pop.
Implement sticky scrolling for the 6-stage 'Our Sciences' manifesto.
Add a fixed WhatsApp floating action button in the bottom right corner with #43B14B background.
Create a Marquee component using framer-motion or react-fast-marquee for the 'ORIGIN • RIGOUR • TRACK RECORD' editorial text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, navbars, or overlays where content sits behind it.
Avoid centered text layouts for long paragraphs. Left-align for editorial feel.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Do not apply `transition: all` to everything; animate specific properties (transform, opacity, background-color).
